frequency_question: How often does the Ministry of Heavy Industries successfully notify a major vehicle financing/subsidy scheme within a 350-day target window from initial proposal?
membership_rule: Includes central government schemes providing direct financial incentives, interest subsidies, or capital outlays specifically targeting automotive manufacturing or adoption (e.g., FAME iterations, PLI Auto). Excludes state-level policies and non-automotive industrial schemes.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the population of major overarching EV and auto PLI schemes in this exact policy class over the past decade
known_gaps: Smaller sub-schemes or administrative tweaks are excluded as they do not match the scale of a primary financing scheme.
skeleton: named cases representing distinct major automotive financial incentive notifications by the Ministry of Heavy Industries
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 major targeted policy formulation attempts tracked under equivalent structural conditions
validity_reason: Policy formulation cadence and bureaucratic structures for automotive subsidies remain stable under the current administrative framework.
